## v0.5.34: Skills that improve with use / 越用越好的技能

Adds Skills, an experimental component for the DSH skills a workspace loads, [#443](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/443).

- A **Skills** page in the Memory System lists every `SKILL.md` DSH loads from the project and from your home, in DSH's order of precedence. Switch a skill off for the model or the `/` menu, use it in the conversation in one click, edit it, and go back to any earlier version.
- With **self-evolution** on, finished conversations are reviewed in the background for corrections, "from now on" instructions, failed tools and reusable procedures. A suggestion cites the steps it rests on; its draft is backtested against the current version on the skill's test cases, and nothing changes a skill without your **Adopt**. Self-evolution is off until you turn it on.
- **Evals** keeps every skill's test cases and backtests, and the conversations reviews read stay as evidence you can turn into cases.
- The **market** searches skills.sh as you type and installs from a featured catalog, any GitHub repository, any site that publishes an Agent Skills discovery index, and catalog files, with a preview that shows skills.sh's security reviews.
- A **Turn skills** line under a turn names the skills it used and what its review suggested. Skills' settings sit on its own page under **Plugins → dsh-mnemon**, tagged **Experimental**, and it can become a sidebar entry of its own.
- dsh-mnemon now describes itself as composable, view-based context for DeepSeek Harness, with layered memory and self-evolving skills out of the box.

新增实验性组件技能管理，管理工作区加载的 DSH 技能，[#443](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/443)。

- 记忆系统新增**技能管理**页面，按 DSH 的优先顺序列出它从项目和用户目录加载的每个 `SKILL.md`。可以让技能不被模型加载或不出现在 `/` 菜单中，一键在对话中使用，直接编辑，并回到任意历史版本。
- 开启**自进化**后，对话结束会在后台复盘，寻找多次纠正、“以后都这样做”的指示、工具失败和可复用的流程。每条建议都标出所依据的步骤；草案先在技能的测试用例上与当前版本回测对比，没有你的**采纳**，任何技能都不会被改动。自进化默认关闭。
- **评测**保存每个技能的测试用例与回测；复盘读过的对话作为证据保留，可以从中生成用例。
- **市场**边输入边搜索 skills.sh，也能从精选目录、任意 GitHub 仓库、按 Agent Skills 发现协议发布技能的网站和技能目录文件安装技能，预览中会显示 skills.sh 的安全审核。
- 回合下方的**本回合技能**一行列出这一回合用到的技能和复盘提出的建议。技能管理的设置在**插件 → 可组合记忆**下它自己的页面上，带有**实验性**标签，也可以作为独立的侧边栏入口。
- dsh-mnemon 的介绍改为：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可组合视图上下文，开箱即用提供分层记忆与自进化技能。

The Starter advances to **0.5.34** and pins a new package, `dsh-mnemon-source-skills` **0.5.1**; the other 17 component versions are unchanged. Existing memory needs no migration. Skills keeps its own data in a new `skills/` folder of the storage root, outside backups and Git sync, and an earlier dsh-mnemon ignores its settings.

Starter 升至 **0.5.34**，并固定新的包 `dsh-mnemon-source-skills` **0.5.1**；其余 17 个组件版本不变，无需迁移已有记忆。技能管理把自己的数据放在存储根目录新增的 `skills/` 文件夹中，不在备份和 Git 同步之内；较早的 dsh-mnemon 会忽略它的设置。

Use **Memory System → Status → Check versions → Update**, then restart DSH; Skills appears with the restart. That works from 0.5.31 and later on every supported DSH, and on DSH 0.2.0 also from 0.5.19 in the WebUI and from 0.5.22 in the desktop app. Older installations, including 0.5.30 and earlier on DSH 0.2.1, update once by hand: quit DSH, install the exact version, then start DSH again:

使用**记忆系统 → 状态 → 检查版本 → 更新**，然后重启 DSH，技能管理会随重启出现。0.5.31 及更高版本在所有受支持的 DSH 上都可以这样更新；在 DSH 0.2.0 上，网页从 0.5.19 起、桌面版从 0.5.22 起也可以。更早的安装，包括 DSH 0.2.1 上的 0.5.30 及更早版本，需要手动更新一次：请退出 DSH，安装精确版本，再启动 DSH：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.34
```

In the desktop app, uninstall dsh-mnemon on the Plugins page, add it again with **Add plugin** as `dsh-mnemon@0.5.34`, then quit the app completely and open it again; memory and settings stay.

桌面版请在插件页**卸载** dsh-mnemon，再通过**添加插件**以 `dsh-mnemon@0.5.34` 重新安装，然后完全退出并重新打开应用；记忆与设置都会保留。
